name: lid-full-arrows
description: LID Full on a mapped brownfield start (M2h): the linked-intent-dev and arrow-maintenance plugins from LID's repository at the release the map was made with, loaded with --plugin-dir as the openGym mapping sessions loaded them (opengym_map.py). Every change is a plain request: the map's own instruction file (update-lid's LID block) sends the agent to the skill, and the arrow overlay (docs/arrows/) is there for arrow-maintenance.
